title: Beyond the Single Turn: Reframing Refusals as Dynamic Experiences Embedded in the Context of Mental Health Support Interactions with LLMs
reasoning: The entire paper evaluates the ethical frameworks and safety guardrails (refusals) of LLMs in mental health contexts, incorporating clinical ethics like 'duty-of-care' and 'do no harm.' It also specifically analyzes interactions where users seek religious or spiritual guidance (e.g., using ChatGPT as a spiritual guide) and critiques how safety models apply Western normative frameworks to those practices.
